A little hint
Try Python outside the farm
You can use Python outside this browser. These are instructions to follow yourself; this preview does not install software.
  1. Download Python 3 from python.org. Run the installer; include Python on PATH when offered.
  2. Open IDLE, choose File → New File, save a .py file, then Run → Run Module.
  3. For notebooks, install Anaconda from its official site, open Navigator and launch Jupyter Notebook. Create a Python notebook; Shift+Enter runs a cell. Follow current official instructions if menus change.
